site.name: Claveria Escape
site.description: Claveria Escape is your guide to Claveria, Misamis Oriental — mountain staycations, waterfalls, cafés & restaurants, and emergency hotlines along the scenic Route 955.

staycation.title: Staycations & Resorts
staycation.blurb: Cabins, campsites, farm resorts and vacation houses in the Claveria highlands.

falls.title: Waterfalls
falls.blurb: Cool, refreshing falls scattered across Claveria's barangays.

cafes.title: Coffee Shops & Restaurants
cafes.blurb: Café stops and resto-bars perfect for breaks along Route 955.

hotlines.title: Emergency Hotlines

Family (up to 6 pax) ₱4,499 · Small Group (7–10) ₱5,499 · Big Group (11–14) ₱6,499 · Fun Crowd (15–18) ₱7,499 · Balangay Crowd (19–22) ₱8,899 · Comunidad Crowd (23–26) ₱10,399 · Tapok Crowd (27–30) ₱12,000

places.name: PBrother's Mountain View Resort

places.location: Zone 4, Lower Lanise, Claveria, Misamis Oriental
places.maps_query: PBrother Mountain View Resort Lower Lanise Claveria Misamis Oriental
extras: Check-in 12:00 PM · Check-out 10:00 AM next day
Extra person ₱500 per head · ₱500 per overnight tent
places.about: PBrother's Mountain View Resort was established in mid-2022 as an intimate, family-friendly hillside retreat in the highland destination of Barangay Lanise, Claveria. Created as a passion project by the Cagampang brothers, it balances the raw, rustic charm of a mountain campsite with the modern comforts of a private villa.

places.name: Janopolan Nature's Spring

places.about: Janopolan Nature's Spring and Pool is one of Claveria's most well-established and deeply rooted public eco-tourism retreats — long before the boutique cabin boom, it served as the original weekend escape for families and travelers looking to experience the raw, natural cooling power of the Misamis Oriental highlands.

places.name: Chenenger Mountain Resort

places.about: Chenenger Mountain Resort (managed in part by the Flores family) was established in late 2022 to provide an affordable, unpretentious retreat in the growing eco-tourism hub of Barangay Lanise, Claveria — a highly practical, home-style communal escape tailored for traditional Filipino group gatherings like family outings and barkada staycations.

places.name: Cabinscape Ridge Resort

places.maps_query: Cabinscape Ridge Resort Mat-i Claveria Misamis Oriental
extras: Regular Cabin (2 pax, max 4) ₱3,500 · Family Cabin (6 pax, max 10) ₱7,500 · Exclusive (18–20 pax) ₱15,000 · Stove usage ₱350
₱50/head photos only · ₱250/head adults with pool · ₱100/head kids 4–12 · Free 3 y/o & below · 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (walk-ins only if not fully booked)
places.about: Cabinscape Ridge Resort quickly became one of Claveria's most photogenic mountain destinations. Built specifically to provide an aesthetic, Nordic-inspired escape from city life, it leans into the naturally cold, mist-covered environment of the Misamis Oriental highlands.

places.name: Aikeeko Farmview Resort

₱500 (small, 2 pax) up to ₱2,000 (big/barkada, up to 8 pax)

Managed by its hands-on CEO, Evangeline Capundag, the property has evolved into a fully equipped mountain resort designed for "farmcations," eco-tourism, and digital detoxing.
